name: string-new
docs: Stringifies and concatenates all arguments after `DESTINATION`, allocates a new string and stores it in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container, `ARGS...` - stringifyable values.

name: string-format
docs: Formats the `FORMAT-STRING` string with all arguments after it, allocates a new string and stores it in `DESTINATION`. Works by replacing all `{}` with the arguments in left-to-right direction. Does not validate format argument count. `DESTINATION` - container, `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `ARGS...` - stringifyable values.

name: string-repeat
docs: Stringifies `STRING`, allocates a new string that is `STRING` repeated `N` times and stores it in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container, `N` - unsigned integer, `STRING` - stringifyable value.

name: string-clear
docs: Clears string. Its memory will still be available. `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-memfree
docs: Clears string and frees its memory. Does not free the string itself and is not necessary to call it before freeing it. `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-empty
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if the string is empty, otherwise 0. `STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-size
docs: Stores the size of the string in `DESTINATION`. `STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-capacity
docs: Stores the capacity (the maximum size before a reallocation) of the string in `DESTINATION`. `STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-reserve
docs: Reserves `N` capacity for the string to prevent unnecessary reallocations. `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer.

name: string-resize
docs: Resizes string to `N` characters. If the new size is greater than the previous then the empty slots are filled with `CHAR`. Might reallocate the string. `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer, `CHAR` - character.

name: string-set
docs: Set a character at position `N` to character `CHAR`. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` >= `SIZE`). `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer, `CHAR` - character.

name: string-at
docs: Get a character at position `N` and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` >= `SIZE`). `STRING` - string, `N` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-back
docs: Get the back (last) character of the string and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if string is empty. `STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-front
docs: Get the front (first) character of the string and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if string is empty. `STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-push
docs: Push `CHAR` at the end of the string. Might reallocate the string. `STRING` - dynamic string, `CHAR` - character.

name: string-insert
docs: Insert `CHAR` at position `N` in the string. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` > `SIZE`). Might reallocate the string. `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer, `CHAR` - character.

name: string-pop
docs: Pop the last character of the string. Throws if string is empty. `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-erase
docs: Erase a character at position `N` in the string. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` >= `SIZE`). `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer.

name: string-free
docs: Frees all strings and sets their values to null. Using a freed string will result in an use-after-free error. `STRING1...` - dynamic strings.

name: string-split
docs: Split the string on `DELIMITER`, allocate an array of the split pieces and store it in `DESTINATION`. Time complexity is O(N*M). Throws if `DELIMITER` is empty. `STRING` - string, `DELIMITER` - string or character, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-concat
docs: Stringifies and concatenate all values after `STRING` to the string. `STRING` - dynamic string, `ARG1...` - any values except for maps.

name: string-substr
docs: Creates a substring [`START`; `END`) from the given string and saves it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if `START` < 0 || `START` >= `SIZE` || `END` < 0 || `END` > `SIZE` || `START` >= `END`. `STRING` - string, `START` - unsigned integer, `END` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-count
docs: Counts the number of occurrences of `TARGET` in the string and stores it in `DESTINATION`. Time complexity if `TARGET` is a character is O(N), whereas if `TARGET` is a string, the complexity is O(N + M), where M is the size of the target string. `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string or character, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-reverse
docs: Reverses the string. Time complexity is O(N/2). `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-find
docs: Attempts to find `TARGET` in the string starting from position `START` (0 to search everything). Returns position if target can be found, otherwise null. Time complexity is O(N*M). Throws if `START` < 0 || `START` > `SIZE`. `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string or character, `START` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-rfind
docs: Attempts to find `TARGET` in the string starting from position `START` (>=`SIZE` or -1 to search everything) in a reverse order. Returns position if target can be found, otherwise null. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string or character, `START` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-find-first-of
docs: Attempts to find the first character found in `TARGET` in the string. Returns position if target can be found, otherwise null. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-find-first-not-of
docs: Attempts to find the first character not found in `TARGET` in the string. Returns position if target can be found, otherwise null. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-find-last-of
docs: Attempts to find the first character found in `TARGET` in the string in a reverse order. Returns position if target can be found, otherwise null. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-find-last-not-of
docs: Attempts to find the first character not found in `TARGET` in the string in a reverse order. Returns position if target can be found, otherwise null. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-replace
docs: Attempts to find `TARGET` in the string and if it does, replaces it with `REPLACEMENT`. Time complexity is O(N*M). Throws if `START` < 0 || `START` > `SIZE`. `STRING` - dynamic string, `TARGET` - string or character, `REPLACEMENT` - string or character, `START` - unsigned integer.

name: string-replace-all
docs: Finds all `TARGET`s in the string and replaces them with `REPLACEMENT`. Time complexity is O(N*M) to O(N\*M\*K) depending on how `TARGET`'s size differs from `REPLACEMENT`'s and on match count. Throws if `REPLACEMENT` is empty. `STRING` - dynamic string, `TARGET` - string or character, `REPLACEMENT` - string or character.

name: string-contains
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `TARGET` is found in the string, else 0. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - string, `TARGET` - string or character, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-erase-all
docs: Erases all characters found in `CHARS` from the string. Time complexity is O(N*M). `STRING` - dynamic string, `CHARS` - string or character.

name: string-starts-with
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if string starts with `START`, else 0. `STRING` - string, `START` - string or character, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-ends-with
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if string ends with `END`, else 0. `STRING` - string, `END` - string or character, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: string-trim
docs: Trims all whitespace from both sides of the string. `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-to-lower
docs: Converts string to lowercase. `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-to-upper
docs: Converts string to uppercase. `STRING` - dynamic string.

name: string-pad-left
docs: Adds padding to `STRING` such that it is at least `N` characters in size. Throws if `N` is less or equal to 0. `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer, `CHAR` - character to pad with.

name: string-pad-right
docs: dds padding to `STRING` such that it is at least `N` characters in size. Throws if `N` is less or equal to 0. `STRING` - dynamic string, `N` - unsigned integer, `CHAR` - character to pad with.

name: string-copy
docs: Copies and allocates a new string into `DESTINATION`. `STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-new
docs: Allocate a new array with all values after `ARRAY` as values. `ARRAY` - container, `ARG1...` - any value.

name: array-fill
docs: Fill an array with `N` `VALUE`s, allocate it and store it in `ARRAY`. `ARRAY` - container, `N` - unsigned integer, `VALUE` - any value.

name: array-iota
docs: Fill an array with `N` incrementing integers starting from `START`, allocate it and store in `ARRAY`. `ARRAY` - container, `N` - unsigned integer, `START` - integer.

name: array-clear
docs: Clears array. Its memory will still be available. `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-memfree
docs: Clears array and frees its memory. Does not free the array itself and is not necessary to call it before freeing it. `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-empty
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if the array is empty, otherwise 0. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-size
docs: Stores the size of the array in `DESTINATION`. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-capacity
docs: Stores the capacity of the array in `DESTINATION`. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-reserve
docs: Reserves `N` capacity for the array to prevent unnecessary reallocations. `ARRAY` - array, `N` - unsigned integer.

name: array-resize
docs: Resizes array to `N` values. If the new size is greater than the previous then the empty slots are filled with `VALUE`. Might reallocate the array. `ARRAY` - array, `N` - unsigned integer, `VALUE` - any value.

name: array-set
docs: Set a value at position `N` to value `VALUE`. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` >= `SIZE`). `ARRAY` - array, `N` - unsigned integer, `VALUE` - any value.

name: array-at
docs: Get a value at position `N` and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` >= `SIZE`). `ARRAY` - array, `N` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-back
docs: Get the back (last) value of the array and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if array is empty. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-front
docs: Get the front (first) value of the array and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if array is empty. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-push
docs: Push `VALUE` at the end of the array. Might reallocate the array. `ARRAY` - array, `VALUE` - ANY VALUE.

name: array-insert
docs: Insert `VALUE` at position `N` in the array. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` > `SIZE`). Might reallocate the array. `ARRAY` - array, `N` - unsigned integer, `VALUE` - any value.

name: array-pop
docs: Pop the last value of the array. Throws if array is empty. `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-erase
docs: Erase the value at position `N` in the array. Throws if `N` is out of bounds (`N` < 0 || `N` >= `SIZE`). `ARRAY` - array, `N` - unsigned integer.

name: array-free
docs: Frees all arrays and sets them to null. Does not free arrays' values. Using a freed array will result in an use-after-free error. `ARRAY1...` - arrays.

name: array-deep-free
docs: Frees all arrays and their values recursively and sets them to null. Using a freed array will result in an use-after-free error. `ARRAY1...` - arrays.

name: array-join
docs: Stringify and concatenate all array's values with the `CONNECTOR` in-between, allocate the result and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if the array contains a map. `ARRAY` - array, `CONNECTOR` - stringifyable value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-concat
docs: Combine `ARRAY1` and `ARRAY2` into one, allocate the result and store it in `DESTINATION`. `ARRAY1` - array, `ARRAY2` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-slice
docs: Slice the array [`START`; `END`), allocate the shallow copy and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if `START` < 0 || `START` >= `SIZE` || `END` < 0 || `END` > `SIZE` || `START` >= `END`. `ARRAY` - array, `START` - unsigned integer, `END` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-shuffle
docs: Randomly shuffle the array based on global RNG. `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-sort
docs: Sort the array based on a callback function. The callback function must take in two arguments and must return a single value. Modifying the array or having improper sort condition can result in undefined behavior. `ARRAY` - array, `CALLBACK` - user-made function.

name: array-sort-asc
docs: Sort the array in an ascending order. Throws if array contains non-comparable types (such as maps, functions, etc.). `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-sort-desc
docs: Sort the array in a descending order. Throws if array contains non-comparable types (such as maps, functions, etc.). `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-count
docs: Count the number of times `VALUE` occurrs in the array and store it in `DESTINATION`. Time complexity is O(N). `ARRAY` - array, `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-reverse
docs: Reverse the array. Time complexity is O(N/2). `ARRAY` - array.

name: array-find
docs: Attempts to find the first occurrence of `VALUE` in the array. Sets `DESTINATION` to the position if it is found, else null. Time complexity is O(N). `ARRAY` - array, `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-contains
docs: Sets `DESTINATION` to 1 if `VALUE` can be found in the array, otherwise 0. Time complexity is O(N). `ARRAY` - array, `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-erase-if
docs: Erases values based on a callback function. The callback function must take in a single argument and must return a single value. A value is erased if a truthy value is returned. Modifying the array while erasing can result in undefined behavior. `ARRAY` - array, `CALLBACK` - user-made function.

name: array-map
docs: Modifies all values based on a callback function. The callback function must take in a single argument and must return a single value. The value returned will be the new value. Modifying the array while mapping values can result in undefined behavior. `ARRAY` - array, `CALLBACK` - user-made function.

name: array-filter
docs: Returns a span of shallow copied array based on a callback function. The callback function must take in a single argument and must return a single value. The element is included in the span if the returned value is truthy. Modifying the array while filtering can result in undefined behavior. Allocates an array. `ARRAY` - array, `CALLBACK` - user-made function, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-reduce
docs: Calculates a value based on a callback function by passing the return value from the previous calculation to the preceding element. Stores the final result in `DESTINATION`. The callback function must take in two arguments and must return a single value. Modifying the array while reducing can result in undefined behavior. `ARRAY` - array, `CALLBACK` - user-made function, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-copy
docs: Shallow copies an array into `DESTINATION`. Only copies references for complex runtime values like dynamic strings, arrays and maps. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: array-deep-copy
docs: Deep copies an array into `DESINATION`. Copies all dynamic strings, arrays and maps recursively. If the array contains multiple identical references to the same object, it is only copied once. `ARRAY` - array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-new
docs: Allocate a new map with all key-value pairs after `MAP` set. Throws if passed argument count is even. `MAP` - container, `KEY1` - key value, `VALUE1` - any value.

name: map-erase
docs: Erase a key-value pair from the map based on the `KEY`. Does nothing if it does not exist. `MAP` - map, `KEY` - key value.

name: map-set
docs: Set or insert a `VALUE` with the key `KEY`. `MAP` - map, `KEY` - key value, `VALUE` - any value.

name: map-at
docs: Get the value at key `KEY` and store it in `DESTINATION`. If there is no value at `KEY`, store null. `MAP` - map, `KEY` - key value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-at-or
docs: Get the value at key `KEY` and store it in `DESTINATION`. If there is no value at `KEY`, add it with the value set to `DEFAULT` and store it in `DESTINATION`. `MAP` - map, `KEY` - key value, `DEFAULT` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-contains
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if a key-value pair with key `KEY` exists, otherwise 0. `MAP` - map, `KEY` - key value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-size
docs: Stores the size of the map in `DESTINATION`. `MAP` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-empty
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if the map is empty, otherwise 0. `MAP` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-clear
docs: Clears all key-value pairs. `MAP` - map.

name: map-keys
docs: Gets all map's keys, allocates an array of them and stores in `DESTINATION`. `MAP` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-values
docs: Gets all map's values, allocates an array of them and stores in `DESTINATION`. `MAP` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-merge
docs: Merge `MAP1` and `MAP2` and store the result in `DESTINATION`. `MAP2`'s values have higher priority. `MAP1` - map, `MAP2` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-free
docs: Frees all maps and sets them to null. Does not free maps' key-value pairs. Using a free map will result in an use-after-free error. `MAP1...` - maps.

name: map-deep-free
docs: Frees all maps and their key-value pairs recursively and sets them to null. Using a freed map will result in an use-after-free error. `MAP1...` - maps.

name: map-copy
docs: Shallow copies a map into `DESTINATION`. Only copies references for complex runtime values like dynamic strings, arrays and maps. `MAP` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: map-deep-copy
docs: Deep copies a map into `DESTINATION`. Copies all dynamic strings, arrays and maps recursively. If the map contains multiple identical references to the same object, it is only copied once. `MAP` - map, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: incr
docs: Increment the value stored in `NUMBER`. `NUMBER` - container containing a number.

name: decr
docs: Decrement the value stored in `NUMBER`. `NUMBER` - container containing a number.

name: sum
docs: Add all numbers together and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if at least a single value is a float. `N1...` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: add
docs: Add `N1` and `N2` together and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if either number is a float. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: sub
docs: Subtract `N1` by `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if either number is a float. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: mul
docs: Multiply `N1` and `N2` together and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if either number is a float. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: div
docs: Divide `N1` by `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if either number is a float. Returns 0 on division by zero. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: mod
docs: Get the remainder of dividing `N1` by `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Supports floats and negative numbers. Returns float if either number is a float. Returns 0 on division by zero. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: fmod
docs: Get the remainder of dividing `N1` by `N2`, using the formula `((N1 % N2) + N2) % N2`, and store in `RESULT`. Supports floats and negative numbers. Returns float if either number is a float. Returns 0 on division by zero. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: pow
docs: Exponentiate `N1` to the exponent `N2`. Returns float if either number is a float. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: neg
docs: Negate `N` and store in `RESULT`. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: sqrt
docs: Get the square root of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. Returns NAN if `N` is negative. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: cbrt
docs: Get the cube root of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: sin
docs: Get the sine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: cos
docs: Get the cosine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: tan
docs: Get the tangent of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: asin
docs: Get the arcsine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: acos
docs: Get the arccosine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: atan
docs: Get the arctangent of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: atan2
docs: Get the arctangent of `Y / X` using the signs of arguments to determine the correct quadrant and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `Y` - number, `X` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: asinh
docs: Get the inverse hyperbolic sine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: acosh
docs: Get the inverse hyperbolic cosine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: atanh
docs: Get the inverse hyperbolic tangent of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: sinh
docs: Get the hyperbolic sine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: cosh
docs: Get the hyperbolic cosine of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: tanh
docs: Get the hyperbolic tangent of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: abs
docs: Get the absolute value of `N` and store in `RESULT`. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: min
docs: Get the minimum value of `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if either value is a float. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: max
docs: Get the maximum value of `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if either value is a float. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: clamp
docs: Clamp `X` to range [`LO`; `HI`] and store in `RESULT`. Returns float if any value is a float. Throws if `LO` > `HI`. `X` - number, `LO` - number, `HI` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: sign
docs: Get the sign of `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns integer. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: trunc
docs: Truncate float `N` and store in `RESULT`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: ceil
docs: Round float `N` to the smallest integer not less than `N`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: floor
docs: Round float `N` to the largest integer not greater than `N`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: round
docs: Round float `N` to the nearest integer. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: exp
docs: Computes Euler's number raised to the power `N`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: ln
docs: Computes the natural (base e) logarithm of `N`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: log
docs: Computes the base `B` logarithm of `N`, using formula `ln(N) / ln(B)`. Returns float. `N` - number, `B` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: log2
docs: Computes the base 2 logarithm of `N`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: log10
docs: Computes the base 10 logarithm of `N`. Returns float. `N` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: lerp
docs: Linearly interpolate `A` to `B` based on `T`. Returns float. `A` - number, `B` - number, `T` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: step-towards
docs: Step towards `TARGET` by 1 until it is reached. Returns float if either value is a float. `N` - number, `TARGET` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: seed-random
docs: Seed the global RNG used in all random operations, like `random`, `randf-range`, `randi-range` and `array-shuffle`. `SEED` - unsigned integer.

name: random
docs: Get a random float in range [0; 1) based on global RNG and store in `RESULT`. `RESULT` - container.

name: randf-range
docs: Get a random float in range [`MIN`; `MAX`) based on global RNG and store in `RESULT`. Throws if `MIN` > `MAX`. `MIN` - number, `MAX` - number, `RESULT` - result.

name: randi-range
docs: Get a random integer in range [`MIN`; `MAX`] based on global RNG and store in `RESULT`. Throws if `MIN` > `MAX`. `MIN` - number, `MAX` - number, `RESULT` - result.

name: gcd
docs: Get the greatest common divisor of `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: lcm
docs: Get the least common multiple of `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. `N1` - number, `N2` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: hypot
docs: Calculate √<s style="text-decoration:overline">x<sup>2</sup>+y<sup>2</sup></s> and store in `RESULT`. `X` - number, `Y` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: hypot3
docs: Calculate √<s style="text-decoration:overline">x<sup>2</sup>+y<sup>2</sup>+z<sup>2</sup></s> and store in `RESULT`. `X` - number, `Y` - number, `Z` - number, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-and
docs: Perform bitwise and operation on `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. `N1` - unsigned integer, `N2` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-or
docs: Perform bitwise or operation on `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. `N1` - unsigned integer, `N2` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-xor
docs: Perform bitwise inclusive or operation on `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. `N1` - unsigned integer, `N2` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-not
docs: Perform bitwise not operation on `N1` and store in `RESULT`. `N1` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-shl
docs: Perform bitwise shift left operation on `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Throws if `N2` >= 64. `N1` - unsigned integer, `N2` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-shr
docs: Perform bitwise shift right operation on `N1` and `N2` and store in `RESULT`. Throws if `N2` >= 64. `N1` - unsigned integer, `N2` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-count
docs: Return the count of set bits in `N` and store in `RESULT`. `N` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-test
docs: Test the bit in `A` at position `N` and store it in `RESULT`. Throws if `N` >= 64. `A` - unsigned integer, `N` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-set
docs: Set the bit in `A` at position `N` and store the result in `RESULT`. Throws if `N` >= 64. `A` - unsigned integer, `N` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-clear
docs: Clear the bit in `A` at position `N` and store the result in `RESULT`. Throws if `N` >= 64. `A` - unsigned integer, `N` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: bit-toggle
docs: Toggle the bit in `A` at position `N` and store the result in `RESULT`. Throws if `N` >= 64. `A` - unsigned integer, `N` - unsigned integer, `RESULT` - container.

name: file-open
docs:
Try to open `PATH` in mode `MODE` and store the file handle in `DESTINATION` on success or null value on failure. Mode `R` - read only, `W` - write only, `A` - write only (append), `X` - read and write. Throws on unknown mode. `PATH` - string, `MODE` - character, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-close
docs:
Close file `FILE` and set the handle to null. `FILE` - file handle.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-read
docs:
Read the whole contents of `FILE`, allocate it and store in `DESTINATION`. `FILE` - file handle, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-readln
docs:
Read a line from `FILE`, allocate it and store in `DESTINATION`. `FILE` - file handle, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-readch
docs:
Read a single character from `FILE` and store in `DESTINATION`. `FILE` - file handle, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-read-bytes
docs:
Read `N` bytes from `FILE`, allocate them and store as a dynamic string in `DESTINATION`. `FILE` - file handle, `N` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-eof
docs:
Store 1 in `DESTINATION` if EOF is found, else 0. `FILE` - file handle, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-write
docs:
Write stringified `DATA` to `FILE`. `FILE` - file handle, `DATA` - stringifyable value.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-writeln
docs:
Write stringified `DATA` to `FILE` and append a newline. `FILE` - file handle, `DATA` - stringifyable value.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-flush
docs:
Flush the output to `FILE`. `FILE` - file handle.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-tell
docs:
Store the current position in `FILE` (in bytes from the start of the file) in `DESTINATION`. Throws if the stream is in a failed state. `FILE` - file handle, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-seek
docs:
Move the position in `FILE` to `POS` bytes from the start of the file. Clears any EOF or error state on the stream. `FILE` - file handle, `POS` - unsigned integer.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-seek-rel
docs:
Move the position in `FILE` by `OFFSET` bytes relative to the current position. A negative `OFFSET` moves backwards. Clears any EOF or error state on the stream. `FILE` - file handle, `OFFSET` - integer.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: file-seek-end
docs:
Move the position in `FILE` by `OFFSET` bytes relative to the end of the file. Clears any EOF or error state on the stream. `FILE` - file handle, `OFFSET` - integer.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-exists
docs:
Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `PATH` exists, otherwise 0. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-is-file
docs:
Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `PATH` exists and is a regular file, otherwise 0. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-is-dir
docs:
Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `PATH` exists and is a directory, otherwise 0. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - contaienr.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-size
docs:
Stores the size `PATH` in `DESTINATION`. Stores null if `PATH` is a directory. Can throw. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-modified-time
docs:
Stores the last modified time of `PATH` in `DESTINATION`. Can throw. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-create-dir
docs:
Recursively creates directories based on `PATH`. Can throw. `PATH` - string.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-remove
docs:
Remove a file or an empty directory based on `PATH`. Can throw. `PATH` - string.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-remove-all
docs:
Remove files and directories recursively based on `PATH`. Can throw. `PATH` - string.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-copy
docs:
Copy `PATH` to `DESTINATION`. Can throw. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - string.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-move
docs:
Move `PATH` to `DESTINATION`. Can throw. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - string.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: path-join
docs: Join both paths together, allocate it and store in `DESTINATION`. `PATH1` - string, `PATH2` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: path-filename
docs: Allocate the filename of the path (dir/file.ext -> file.ext) and store it in `DESTINATION`. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: path-stem
docs: Allocate the stem of the path (dir/file.ext -> file) and store it in `DESTINATION`. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: path-extension
docs: Allocate the extension of the path (dir/file.ext -> .ext) and store it in `DESTINATION`. Files with extensions return their extension starting with a dot, whereas files with no extension will return an empty string. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: path-parent
docs: Allocate the parent of the path (dir/file.ext -> dir/) and store it in `DESTINATION`. Returns a copy of `PATH` if no parent is present. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: path-absolute
docs: Allocate the absolute path of `PATH` and store it in `DESTINATION`. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: path-normalize
docs: Allocate the lexically normal path of `PATH` and store it in `DESTINATION`. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: dir-list
docs:
Allocate an array of all paths of files and directories found in `PATH` and store it in `DESTINATION`. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: dir-list-recursive
docs:
Allocate an array of all paths of files and directories recursively found in `PATH` and store it in `DESTINATION`. `PATH` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: os-name
docs: Allocate and return the name of the user's OS. Windows - `windows`, MacOS - `macos`, Linux - `linux`, any other OS - `unknown`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: os-cwd
docs:
Allocate the current working directory and store in `DESTINATION`. Can throw. `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: os-set-cwd
docs:
Set the current working directory to `PATH`. Can throw. `PATH` - string.

Must have file I/O permissions.

name: os-env-get
docs:
Get environment variable `VAR` and store it in `DESTINATION`. Stores null if it doesn't exist. `VAR` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have environment permissions.

name: os-env-set
docs:
Set environment variable `VAR` to stringified value `VALUE`. `VAR` - string, `VALUE` - stringifyable value.

Must have environment permissions.

name: os-args
docs: Allocate the passed OS arguments in an array of strings and store it in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: os-exec
docs:
Execute command `COMMAND` and store any output up until 4KiB in `DESTINATION`. Throws if cannot open pipe. `COMMAND` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

Must have command execution permissions.

name: os-exit-code
docs: Stores the last exit code from `os-exec` in `DESTINATION`. By default it is 0. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: flush
docs: Flush the output to the terminal.

name: stdin-eof
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if stdin contains EOF, otherwise 0. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: printch
docs: Output a single character to the terminal. `CHAR` - character.

name: print
docs: Output all `ARGS` to the terminal. Does not output a separator or a newline. `ARGS...` - any value.

name: println
docs: Output all `ARGS` to the terminal including a newline. Does not output a separator. `ARGS...` - any value.

name: printf
docs: Formats the `FORMAT-STRING` string with all arguments after it and outputs it to the terminal. Works by replacing all `{}` with the arguments in left-to-right direction. Does not validate format argument count. `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `ARG1...` - stringifyable value.

name: printfln
docs: Formats the `FORMAT-STRING` string with all arguments after it and outputs it and a newline to the terminal. Works by replacing all `{}` with the arguments in left-to-right direction. Does not validate format argument count. `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `ARG1...` - stringifyable value.

name: read
docs: Read a single word (until a whitespace is hit) from the user, allocate it as a string and store it in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: readln
docs: Read a whole line (until a newline is hit) from the user, allocate it as a string and store it in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: readch
docs: Read a single character from the user and store it in `DESTINATION`. Does not output the character to the console nor wait for a newline. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: setecho
docs: Set terminal echo based on `VALUE`s truthiness. 0 - off, otherwise on. When echo is off, nothing is output to the terminal. Does not change behavior of `readch`. `VALUE` - any value.

name: le
docs: Checks if `A` is less than `B` and if it is, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. Types of `A` and `B` must match, although integers can be compared to floats. `A` - number, character or any string, `B` - number, character or any string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: gr
docs: Checks if `A` is greater than `B` and if it is, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. Types of `A` and `B` must match, although integers can be compared to floats. `A` - number, character or any string, `B` - number, character or any string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: leeq
docs: Checks if `A` is less than or equal to `B` and if it is, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. Types of `A` and `B` must match, although integers can be compared to floats. `A` - number, character or any string, `B` - number, character or any string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: greq
docs: Checks if `A` is greater than or equal to `B` and if it is, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. Types of `A` and `B` must match, although integers can be compared to floats. `A` - number, character or any string, `B` - number, character or any string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: eq
docs: Checks if `A` is equal to `B` and if it is, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. If `A` and `B` don't share the same type 0 is stored, comparing integers to floats is an exception. `A` - number, character, any string or array, `B` - number, character, any string or array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: neq
docs: Checks if `A` is not equal to `B` and if it's not, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. If `A` and `B` don't share the same type 1 is stored, comparing integers to floats is an exception. `A` - number, character, any string or array, `B` - number, character, any string or array, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: and
docs: Checks if both `A` and `B` are true and if so, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. `A` - any value, `B` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: or
docs: Checks if either `A` or `B` is true and if so, stores 1 in `DESTINATION`, otherwise 0. `A` - any value, `B` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: not
docs: Stores the opposite of `VALUE`s truthiness in `DESTINATION` - if it is 0, then 1, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: goto
docs: Unconditionally jumps to `LABEL`. `LABEL` - label.

name: jmp
docs: Jumps to `LABEL` if `CONDITION` is truthy, otherwise does nothing. `CONDITION` - any value, `LABEL` - label.

name: jmpn
docs: Jumps to `LABEL` if `CONDITION` is not truthy, otherwise does nothing. `CONDITION` - any value, `LABEL` - label.

name: jmptable
docs: Checks `VALUE` against all `TARGET`s and if there is a match, then jump to the label after it. If the passed argument count is even and there are no matches, jump to `DEFAULT-LABEL`, otherwise do nothing. Each `TARGET` must have a corresponding `LABEL` after it. `VALUE` - number, character, any string or array, `TARGET...` - number, character, any string or array, `LABEL...` - label, `DEFAULT-LABEL?` - optional label.

name: call
docs: Calls `FUNCTION` with given arguments `ARGS...` (if any) and stores all of the returns in `RETURNS...` (if any). Throws if `ARGS...` count does not match `FUNCTION`s arity or if `FUNCTION` is not parse-time. For runtime function calls use [func-call](https://pil-esolang.github.io/built-ins/builtins/#func-call). Throws a warning if `RETURNS...` count does not match actual returned value count. `RETURNS...` - containers, `FUNCTION` - function, `ARGS...` - any value.

name: func-call
docs: Calls `FUNCTION` with given arguments `ARGS...` (if any). Throws if `ARGS...` count does not match `FUNCTION`'s arity. `FUNCTION` - function, `ARGS...` - any value.

name: return
docs: Returns from the function and stores all `VALUES...` (if any) in return registers. Exits the program if called from main function. `VALUES...` - any value.

name: catch
docs: Calls `FUNCTION` with given arguments `ARGS...` (if any) and allocates and stores all errors as an array of strings in `DESTINATION` if any were thrown, otherwise stores null. Throws if `ARGS...` count does not match `FUNCTION`'s arity. `DESTINATION` - container, `FUNCTION` - function, `ARGS...` - any value.

name: assert
docs: Exits the program and formats the `FORMAT-STRING` in the same manner as [printf](https://pil-esolang.github.io/built-ins/builtins/#printf) if `CONDITION` is not truthy. Does not precompute the message if the `CONDITION` is truthy. `CONDITION` - any value, `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `ARGS...` - stringifyable value.

name: warn
docs: Formats the `FORMAT-STRING` in the same manner as [printf](https://pil-esolang.github.io/built-ins/builtins/#printf) and outputs it as a warning. `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `ARGS...` - stringifyable value.

name: error
docs: Formats the `FORMAT-STRING` in the same manner as [printf](https://pil-esolang.github.io/built-ins/builtins/#printf), outputs it as an error and as long as the error isn't caught using [catch](https://pil-esolang.github.io/built-ins/builtins/#catch), exits the program. `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `ARGS...` - stringifyable value.

name: exit
docs: Unconditionally exits the program with exit code `CODE`. An erroneous code is any code except for 0. `CODE` - number.

name: stack-depth
docs: Stores the depth of the stack in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: stack-name
docs: Allocates and stores the name of the calee's function in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: stack-line
docs: Stores the line of calee's function in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: stack-file
docs: Allocates and stores the name of the file of the calee's function in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: stack-trace
docs: Dumps the stack trace and exits the program.

name: typeof
docs: Allocates and stores the name of the type of `VALUE` in `DESTINATION`. Integer - `int`, float - `float`, character - `char`, constant and dynamic strings - `string`, array - `array`, map - `map`, function - `function`, label - `label`, null - `null`. `VALUE` - any value. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-num
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a number, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-float
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a float, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-int
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is an integer, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-char
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a character, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-string
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a string, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-dynamic-string
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a dynamically allocated string, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-constant-string
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a constant string, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-array
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is an array, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-map
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a map, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-file-handle
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a file handle, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-var
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a container, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-function
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a function, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-label
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a label, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-struct
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a structure, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-of-struct
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is of struct `STRUCT`, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - array, `STRUCT` - structure, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-null
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is null, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-inf
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a float and infinite, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: is-nan
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `VALUE` is a float and NaN, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: to-int
docs: Converts `VALUE` to an integer and stores it in `DESTINATION`. If `VALUE` is a string and it isn't a valid number or is out of bounds, store null instead. `VALUE` - number, character or string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: to-float
docs: Converts `VALUE` to a float and stores it in `DESTINATION`. If `VALUE` is a string and it isn't a valid number or is out of bounds, store null instead. `VALUE` - number, character or string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: to-char
docs: Converts `VALUE` to a character and stores it in `DESTINATION`. `VALUE` - number or character. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: time
docs: Stores the elapsed time in milliseconds since the first [time](https://pil-esolang.github.io/built-ins/builtins/#time) call in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: unix-time
docs: Stores seconds since epoch in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: date
docs: Formats and allocates a date based on `FORMAT-STRING`. All format options are available [here](https://en.cppreference.com/cpp/io/manip/put_time). All of them are available and are prefixed with `%`. `FORMAT-STRING` - string, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: sleep
docs: Sleep for `SECONDS` seconds. `SECONDS` - number.

name: swap
docs: Swap both values in the given containers. `A` - container, `B` - container.

name: set
docs: Store `VALUE` in `DESTINATION`. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: valtable
docs: Checks `VALUE` against all `TARGET`s and if there is a match, store the value after the `TARGET` in `DESTINATION`. Otherwise if there is an odd number of arguments, store `DEFAULT?`, else null. Each `TARGET` must have a `RESULT` after it. `VALUE` - any value except for map, `DESTINATION` - container, `TARGET...` - any value except for map, `RESULT...` - any value, `DEFAULT?` - optional value.
code: valtable VALUE, DESTINATION, TARGET, RESULT, ..., DEFAULT?

name: table-contains
docs: Checks whether `VALUE` matches any of the values and stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if it does, otherwise 0. `VALUE` - any value except for map, `DESTINATION` - container, `TARGET...` - any value except for map.

name: return-at
docs: Get the value of the return register at position `ID` and store it in `DESTINATION`. Throws if `ID` is out of bounds. `ID` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: return-count
docs: Stores the number of values returned by the last function call in `DESTINATION`. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: func-arity
docs: Stores the parameter count of `FUNCTION` in `DESTINATION`. `FUNCTION` - function, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: func-variadic
docs: Stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if `FUNCTION` is variadic, otherwise 0. `FUNCTION` - function, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: func-arg-match
docs: Checks whether `ARGS` would be a valid argument count for `FUNCTION` and stores 1 in `DESTINATION` if so, otherwise 0. `FUNCTION` - function, `ARGS` - unsigned integer, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: make
docs: Create a new structure based on `STRUCT` template and store in `DESTINATION`. `ARGS...` count must match structure's field count. `STRUCT` - structure, `DESTINATION` - container, `ARGS...` - any value.

name: free
docs: Deallocates all values. Throws if an argument is not an allocated value. `ARGS...` - string, array or map.

name: deep-free
docs: Deallocates all values and deallocates all children recursively if container has any. Throws if an argument is not an allocated value. `ARGS...` - string, array or map.

name: copy
docs: Shallow copy `VALUE` to `DESTINATION`. Allocates the value if it is allocated. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: deep-copy
docs: Deep copy `VALUE` to `DESTINATION`. Allocates the value if it is allocated and all its children. If the container contains multiple identical references to the same object, it is only copied once. `VALUE` - any value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: size
docs: Takes and stores the size of `VALUE` in `DESTINATION`. If `VALUE` is not a container, stores 1. `VALUE` - any value. `DESTINATION` - container.

name: at
docs: Stores the value at `KEY` in `DESTINATION`. For maps `KEY` is the literal key and for arrays and strings it is the index. Throws if key is of incorrect type (non-integer for strings and arrays or non-key type for maps) or if it is out of bounds. Throws if `CONTAINER` cannot be accessed. `CONTAINER` - string, array or map, `KEY` - integer/key value, `DESTINATION` - container.

name: store
docs: Store `VALUE` at `KEY`. For maps `KEY` is the literal key and for arrays and strings it is the index. Throws if key is of incorrect type (non-integer for strings and arrays or non-key type for maps) or if it is out of bounds. Throws if `CONTAINER` cannot be accessed. `CONTAINER` - dynamic string, array or map, `KEY` - integer/key value, `VALUE` - any value.
